g.text: Partition by Product, Bridge by Integration Point
One graph per product keeps queries fast. Cross-product reasoning runs over the bridges.
THREE AGENT VARIANTS HANDLE THE PARTITION
"What in this product is affected by this change?"
"What in other products is affected via integration points?"
"What duplicated capability exists across the portfolio?"
The expensive cross-product traversal happens at spec time. The cheap single-product traversal happens at every change.
